title: Security Forces Kill 7 Militants Using Quadcopter Strike in Bannu's Ghora Baka Khel
detail: Pakistani security forces killed at least seven militants in the Ghora Baka Khel area of Bannu, KP, on June 26, 2026, using a quadcopter drone to target a vehicle loaded with weapons and explosives — a rare instance of Pakistani forces using the same quadcopter tactic that TTP-linked cells have increasingly deployed against them in the district.

sources.name: Dawn — At least 7 terrorists killed in operation in KP's Bannu: security sources

media.caption: Pakistani security forces used a quadcopter strike to kill 7 militants in Bannu's Ghora Baka Khel area.
